title: Queen Gift!
reviewNotes: Montages, captions and native complete diagrams reviewed. Native74 confirms the complete thirteen-piece final checked board: White Kh1/Qd2/Rc1/e5/f4/g3/h4 against Kh8/Bc5/Rh2/b6/g7/h6. Qxh2 and Kxh2 are the only legal answers to the rook check. Independent Qxh2/Be3/Rc8+/Kh7 demonstrates that the back-rank rook check is not mate: Kh7 is its only legal answer. Independent Kxh2/Bg1+/Kh3 is another legal check/escape comparison. These source-unplayed continuations retain twelve pieces after the rook capture and do not certify either root outcome. Black’s clock win must not be confused with a forced Black board win. Analyze every bishop/king/pawn defense and the complete queen/rook conversion, keeping b6/g7/h6 and e5/f4/g3/h4 accounted for. Prior root, bishop-capture comparisons and all review history remain preserved; source images and captions are available.
